examples.text: 星天准备得很到位，咱们也得好好表现。
examples.trans: Xingtian prepared thoroughly, so we should perform well too.

examples.text: 小谷在现场的表现非常稳重。
examples.trans: Xiaogu handled herself very steadily on set.

examples.text: 星天有很多部门，这些部门之间都是平行的。
examples.trans: Xingtian has many departments, and all of these departments are on equal footing.

examples.text: 黄金一班的事有你的功劳，也有许天泽的功劳，主要是许天泽的功劳。
examples.trans: You deserve credit for the Golden Class reunion, and so does your rich friend — mostly him.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

We are mainly responsible for the live broadcast.

examples.text: 我本来是想着可以把她留在总编室，早点转正。
examples.trans: Originally I was planning to keep her in the chief editor's office and make her permanent early.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 那儿就是淳于乔的总编室。
examples.trans: Over there is Chun Yuqiao's chief editor's office.

examples.text: 布小谷的策划比二部的更有新意。
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu's proposal is fresher than Unit Two's.

examples.text: 我竟这样完成了自己的第一个策划。
examples.trans: That was how I completed my very first show proposal.

examples.trans: The new contract takes effect next Monday.

examples.text: 感觉非常好，还要谢谢方老师推荐。

examples.text: 最后留下的概率并不是很高。
examples.trans: The chance of staying on at the end is really not very high.
